    AI Overview
    The 2026 Men's Final Four takes place Saturday, April 4, with games airing on
    TBS, TNT, and truTV, featuring (2) UConn vs. (3) Illinois at 6:09 p.m. ET, followed by (1) Michigan vs. (1) Arizona at approx. 8:49 p.m. ET. The National Championship is Monday, April 6, at 8:50 p.m. ET on the same networks. 
    2026 Men's Final Four TV Schedule (April 4) 
    • Game 1 (6:09 p.m. ET): UConn vs. Illinois
    • Game 2 (approx. 8:49 p.m. ET): Michigan vs. Arizona
    • Channel: TBS, TNT, and truTV are broadcasting the games.
    • Streaming Options: NCAA March Madness Live, Max, Sling TV, DirecTV. 
    National Championship Game (April 6) 
    • Time: 8:50 p.m. ET
    • Channel: TBS, TNT, and truTV 
    All games take place at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.
